faqLeft.q: What engine does the Mercedes CLK 55 AMG use?
faqLeft.a: It depends on the generation. From 1997 to 2003 (C208), the CLK 55 AMG used the M113 5.5-litre V8. From 2002 to 2009 (C209), it switched to the M273 5.5-litre V8 — a different engine. Send us your registration and we'll confirm which one your car has.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Mercedes CLK 55 AMG engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £4,500, for either engine code. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my CLK 55 AMG?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm whether you have the M113 or the M273 before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild M113 CLK 55 AMG engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace timing chains, bearings, and gaskets as standard on every M113 rebuild.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild M273 CLK 55 AMG engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. The M273 is a different V8 unit, and we service it to the same standard as the M113, replacing timing chains, bearings, and gaskets.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used CLK 55 AMG engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my CLK 55 AMG if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a CLK 55 AMG engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most CLK 55 AMG owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.

faqRight.q: Is the CLK 55 AMG still in production?
faqRight.a: No, the CLK 55 AMG was discontinued in 2009. We continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
